title: Security Synthesis
reward: Integrate the previous thirteen gates into disciplined security reasoning.
knowledge: Start from topology and evidence boundary, then time/state/service baseline, then sequence and cross-source correlation.
Separate operational failure, suspicious behavior, hostile-looking behavior and demonstrated impact.
Maintain competing hypotheses until evidence discriminates them.
Use learned knowledge to ask better questions, never to expand enforcement authority.
The mature observer knows both what it has learned and where its knowledge ends.
Completion is not graduation from rules; stronger knowledge requires stricter epistemic discipline.
challenge: Produce an evidence ledger with supporting, conflicting and missing evidence across layers.
State the strongest justified conclusion and a stricter conclusion that remains unjustified.
Self-review for overclaiming before requesting human/maintainer review.
next_requires: No automatic higher authority; future curriculum requires governed human review.
